cohort: The cohort consisted of 94 women aged 40 years or younger with pathologically confirmed bilateral serous borderline ovarian tumors.
finding: Fertility preservation with bilateral ovarian cystectomy for bilateral serous borderline ovarian tumors is feasible with acceptable oncological and pregnancy outcomes, although preoperative CA-125 > 300 U/mL, fertility preservation, and micropapillary pattern were independently associated with adverse disease-free survival.
